messages:
mattg: Quick check before I flip HPA metrics in prod terraform. Planning to set module.autoscaler.enable_hpa_metrics = true and apply. Does this require any Vault -> k8s secret sync changes for prometheus-adapter? cc @julia @sanjay

mattg: example HPA I'm going to enable (small change):
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: web-hpa
  annotations:
    karpenter.sh/provisioner-name: "default-provisioner"
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: web
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 60
```

julia: If the HPA uses metrics from prometheus-adapter, we need the adapter's service account token mounted. Is the autoscaler module already configured to sync the Vault path to k8s secret? which path currently?

sanjay: The module creates the k8s secret but our Vault paths moved. Current canonical path is `secrets/observability/prom-adapter`. The TF var is `k8s_secret_path` in module.autoscaler. We need to change that in prod workspace before enabling.

sanjay: quick local diff I ran:
```
module.autoscaler.k8s_secret_path: "secrets/observability/prom-adapter" => "secrets/observability/prom-adapter"
# provider mapping: vault -> kube secret sync resource needs to run in apply
```

olivia: Also validate the prometheus-adapter deployment expects the mounted token at `PROM_ADAPTER_TOKEN_PATH`. We removed fallback to cluster token last quarter so missing mount will break scrapes.

mattg: OK - I'll add a tiny TF change to set `k8s_secret_path = "secrets/observability/prom-adapter"` in prod and update the module README. Won't flip enable_hpa_metrics until that applies.

julia: While you're there, add a note in README about the vault path + how to run the sync job. Small docs save future churning. Also add a changelog entry.

mattg: will do. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/auto/hpa-metrics-vault-sync-524 — will tag once created.

deploy-bot: CI started for branch auto/hpa-metrics-vault-sync-524 — terraform fmt + validate.

sanjay: FYI: Karpenter label usage for burst provisioning: some clusters rely on `karpenter.sh/capacity-type: spot`. If HPA causes a spike and Karpenter falls back to on-demand, ensure provisioning policy has consolidation disabled during the transient to avoid repeated churn.

olivia: I can flip the var in staging and run a short load test if you want a rehearsal. Also will watch `prom_adapter_scrape_errors` and `horizontal_pod_autoscaler_unavailable` metrics.

mattg: staging test please, that would be great. Plan: stage flip -> run k6 load -> confirm adapter scrapes + HPA reacts -> prod TF apply -> flip HPA -> monitor 30m.

julia: +1 and add an alert runbook snippet: rollback tf var and scale deployment replicas to previous count if adapter fails.

mattg: added to PR description. Thanks all :thumbsup:
